stem: Over the same 30 days, store A's headphones were sold out on 6 days and sell 1 unit a day when in stock. Store B's were sold out on 2 days and sell 5 units a day when in stock. Using Voltmarkt's lost sales convention, which statement is right?

options.text: Store A lost more units, because it was sold out on more days
Store B lost more units, about 10 against 6 for store A
Both lost the same, because lost sales follow the stockout rate
Neither can be estimated without a promotion baseline for each store
